name: Scholar’s Anchoring Bangle

source.note: Compared with the published D&D Beyond chapter on 2026-10-06: https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/au/chapter-5-magic-items. Mechanics checked against the chapter. Prices use the existing rarity convention, not book-specific prices; unspecified weights use 0, and templates inherit base-item weight.

summary: A proficient Study check treats rolls under 10 as 10; once a day a Reaction saves your Concentration.
text: While wearing this bangle, when you make an Intelligence check with a skill you're proficient in to Study, a d20 roll of 9 or lower counts as a 10. Once per dawn, when you fail a Constitution saving throw to keep Concentration, you can take a Reaction to succeed instead.

powers.name: Anchor the Spell
powers.text: Once a day, used on its own: a failed Concentration save succeeds.
